title: Randomized Clinical Trial of Bococizumab (PF-04950615; RN316) in Subjects With Hyperlipidemia or Mixed Dyslipidemia at Risk of Cardiovascular Events

sections.abstract:
This study is a multicenter, randomized study in subjects with high cholesterol receiving highly effective statins to assess the efficacy, safety and tolerability of Bococizumab (PF-04950615;RN316) to lower LDL-C.

Posted outcomes: Percent Change From Baseline in Fasting Low Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C) at Week 12. timeframe=Baseline, Week 12. Placebo (Treatment Period)=1.0 (±22.55); Bococizumab 150 mg (Treatment Period)=-54.9 (±26.84). p=<0.001
